label: Privacy policy
default:
RayG Handyman Service (“we”, “us”, “our”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect through our website, how we use it, who we share it with, and your rights under UK data protection law.

## 1. Who we are

The data controller is **RayG Handyman Service**, based at 45 Blackhalve Lane, Wolverhampton, WV11 1BQ, United Kingdom.

- Email: [enquiries@rayghandymanservice.co.uk](mailto:enquiries@rayghandymanservice.co.uk)
- Phone: [07379 195256](tel:+447379195256)

The site and our business dashboard are built and run by HapiTech on our behalf. Email is provided by Namecheap.

## 2. What data we collect

We only collect information that you voluntarily provide or that is necessary to run the site securely:

- **Contact form:** name, email address, phone number (optional), location/area, postcode (optional), message, and any travel-cost estimate generated.
- **If you book work with us:** the job details, date, address (if you give it), quotes and invoices.
- **Reviews you leave here:** your name, star rating, words and any photos. If you give your email, it's only used to check you're one of our customers and isn't shown or kept with the review.
- **Visits:** we count visits without cookies, recording only which page was viewed and which website you came from (for example Google), nothing that identifies you.
- **Technical logs:** our server may record standard logs such as IP address, browser type, pages visited, and timestamps for security and troubleshooting.

We do not use analytics cookies or tracking pixels, and we do not ask you to create an account.

## 3. How we use your data

- To respond to your enquiry and provide a quote.
- To estimate travel costs for jobs outside our standard free-service radius.
- To arrange your job: booking confirmation, a reminder the day before, and your invoice. After the job we may email you an optional link to leave a review. We only send a "remind me next time" email if you ask for one, and you can stop it with one click.
- To keep a record of communications for customer service, warranty, and legal purposes.
- To show reviews on this website and on HapiTech Reviews (hapitech.report). Reviews you've left on Google or Facebook may also be shown, exactly as they appear there, with a link back to the original.
- To maintain the security and performance of the website, including spam checks on the contact form (it checks how quickly the form was filled in, and your IP address is held briefly in memory to limit repeat submissions; it isn't stored).

The legal bases we rely on are **legitimate interests** and taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract.

## 4. Who we share data with

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with trusted service providers who help us operate the site and respond to enquiries:

- **HapiTech** – builds and runs the website and our business dashboard on a server it manages. Enquiries, jobs, quotes, invoices and reviews are stored there.
- **Namecheap** – email service (mail.privateemail.com). Messages you send through the contact form are also delivered to our enquiries mailbox hosted by Namecheap.
- **Postcodes.io** – when you enter a postcode in the contact form, it is sent from your browser to Postcodes.io to look up coordinates and calculate distance. Postcodes.io does not receive your name, email, or message.
- **Google Fonts** – the site loads fonts from Google’s CDN. Your browser may share your IP address with Google when fetching fonts. Google Fonts does not set cookies.

## 5. How long we keep your data

Enquiries that don't go ahead are deleted automatically after 30 days. Details of work we've done, and enquiry emails, are kept for as long as necessary to fulfil your request, manage ongoing work, and meet legal or tax record-keeping requirements. You can ask us to delete your data at any time (see below).

## 6. Cookies

We do not use non-essential cookies, advertising cookies, or analytics tracking. Any cookies set are strictly necessary for the normal operation of the website or its hosting. If you tap ♥ on a photo, your browser remembers your like on your own device; nothing about you is sent to us.

## 7. Your rights

Under UK GDPR you have the right to:

- Access the personal data we hold about you.
- Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
- Ask us to erase your data in certain circumstances.
- Restrict or object to our processing of your data.
- Request a portable copy of your data.
- Withdraw consent at any time, where processing is based on consent.
- Lodge a complaint with the [Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO)](https://ico.org.uk/).

To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details above.

## 8. Security

We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data. The website and dashboard use encrypted (HTTPS) connections, and email is sent over TLS where supported by the receiving server. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page with the updated date.

## 9. Governing law

## 10. Changes to these terms

If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us at [enquiries@rayghandymanservice.co.uk](mailto:enquiries@rayghandymanservice.co.uk) or call [07379 195256](tel:+447379195256).
